paper.title_en: Boundary Obstructions and Lapse Freedom in Static Spherical Hollow Cores
paper.abstract_en: We analyze a sharply delimited comparison problem for a static spherical hollow core: an empty, flat cavity surrounded by a positive matter wall. In the unit-lapse, flat-slice radial Painleve--Gullstrand (PG) class the Type-I source obeys $p_r=-ρ$ and $p_\perp=-ρ-rρ'/2$. A regular nonnegative density that rises out of the cavity must therefore violate the transverse null and weak energy conditions. We quantify this boundary obstruction by an exact weighted onset budget and a depth--width bound, and show that the sharp limit has the same negative tangential pressure as its symmetry-invariant regularized Israel layer. We then close the adjacent unit-lapse, curved-slice route under a monotone areal-radius hypothesis. Finally, when only the lapse is released, an incomplete-beta family gives regular hollow shells with flat cavities, Schwarzschild exteriors, no thin shells, and NEC/WEC/SEC/DEC on an explicit compactness interval. The family is conditionally characterized in the minimum-degree and $p_r=0$ sectors and admits a fixed-ADM-mass cavity redshift benchmark. The result is a static boundary theorem and construction, not a general hollow-shell existence theorem, a transport result, or an experimental feasibility claim.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究静态球对称空心核中的边界阻碍和时移自由度，属于广义相对论基础中的构造性边界定理，与主题相关。
decision.title_zh: 静态球对称空心核中的边界阻碍与度规函数自由度
decision.abstract_zh: 我们分析了一个边界清晰的对比问题，涉及静态球对称空心核：一个空的、平坦的空腔，周围是正物质壁。在单位时移、平坦切片径向Painleve–Gullstrand (PG)类中，I型源满足$p_r=-ρ$和$p_\perp=-ρ-rρ'/2$。一个从空腔上升的正则非负密度因此必须违反横向零能量条件和弱能量条件。我们通过一个精确的加权起始预算和一个深度-宽度界限来量化这种边界阻碍，并证明尖锐极限具有与其对称不变的规则化Israel层相同的负横向压力。然后，在单调面积半径假设下，我们封闭相邻的单位时移、弯曲切片路径。最后，当仅释放时移时，一个不完全β族给出具有平坦空腔、Schwarzschild外部、无薄壳以及在显式紧致性区间上满足NEC/WEC/SEC/DEC的正则空心壳。该族在最小度和$p_r=0$扇区中被条件表征，并允许一个固定ADM质量空腔红移基准。结果是静态边界定理和构造，而不是一般空心壳存在性定理、传输结果或实验可行性声明。
